programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population

programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #1
programme.desc: 丹尼爾的新盟友(後轉為室友)考驗著阿曼達的耐心。米格爾在墨西哥尋找親生父親。泰瑞則開始對「眼鏡蛇道館」進行大改造。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #2
programme.desc: 喬善和丹尼爾策劃了一個針對泰瑞的冒險計畫。在墨西哥,羅比和強尼正在尋找米格爾,而米格爾發現了關於他父親的真相。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #3
programme.desc: 丹尼爾過去的另一個敵人重新浮出���面。經過一天的 SPA 水療和一番內心掙扎後,珊對於她與米格爾的未來做出了決定。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #4
programme.desc: 強尼和卡門的情事進展順利,而丹尼爾和阿曼達則被泰瑞的陰謀搞得心神不寧。青少年們的恩怨延燒到了水上樂園。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #5
programme.desc: 丹尼爾依靠一位朋友——也是「亦敵亦友」的夥伴。米格爾和羅比的緊張關係達到頂點。一張熟悉的面孔回歸了。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #6
programme.desc: 泰瑞招募了一位精通「拳法之道」的專家。丹尼爾選擇遠離紛爭,強尼和喬善卻主動挑起戰火。在監獄裡,克里斯正視著內心的心魔。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #7
programme.desc: 泰瑞和金發起了一項殘酷的挑戰,而喬善則教導他的學生們不同的一課。強尼和丹尼爾要求克里斯給出交代。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #8
programme.desc: 一個爭奪國際頂尖賽事名額的機會引發了道館間的激戰。多莉的忠誠度受到考驗。珊則難以放下米格爾。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #9
programme.desc: 多莉為她的反抗付出了代價。魟魚正與他的良知搏鬥。強尼、丹尼爾和喬善在城裡的慶祝之夜發生了意外轉折。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #10
programme.desc: 山谷區爆發了一場決戰之夜,強尼、丹尼爾、喬善和他們的學生們集結了所有的技能與力量,誓要揭發並擊垮泰瑞。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #1
programme.desc: 強尼勞倫斯在輸掉全谷空手道錦標賽34年後,決定重開眼鏡蛇道場,而他學校的對手丹尼爾拉魯索則經營著一家成功的汽車公司。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #2
programme.desc: 丹尼爾沮喪地發現全新的眼鏡蛇道場已經開業。強尼瞭解到他的道場真正開始教學前必須通過幾項安全要求。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #3
programme.desc: 米格爾幫助強尼在網上宣傳眼鏡蛇道場。丹尼爾同意在萬聖節舞會上擔任監護人,以便可以看顧女兒。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #4
programme.desc: 羅比與父親關係緊張。強尼因米格爾受傷而計畫關閉眼鏡蛇道場。薩曼莎和凱勒的關係跌至谷底。被破壞的廣告板讓丹尼爾繃緊。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #5
programme.desc: 眼鏡蛇道場接收第二位學生。丹尼爾有一個複雜的計劃來報復強尼。米格爾在午休時為捍衛薩曼莎而對抗凱勒。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #6
programme.desc: 強尼的道場課吸引一群不合的人,而他心懷不軌的兒子羅比則找到一份新工作。薩曼莎在科學課上結識一位新朋友。丹尼爾激發了一個意想不到的人對空手道的興趣。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #7
programme.desc: 強尼得知眼鏡蛇道場被禁止參加全谷錦標賽後跟市議會對質。米格爾約會薩曼莎。羅比向丹尼爾學習,而他的夥伴則策劃搶劫拉魯索汽車公司。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #8
programme.desc: 強尼為他的眼鏡蛇道場學生準備下一屆全谷空手道錦標賽,他也反過來受啟發去改過自新。丹尼爾還不知道他新學生的背景。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #9
programme.desc: 路易的魯莽行為逼使強尼和丹尼爾回憶往事。眼鏡蛇道場學生密謀對受歡迎的孩子進行報復。米格爾對薩曼莎慢慢失去耐性。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #10
programme.desc: 今天是2018年度全谷空手道錦標賽,眼鏡蛇道場決心取勝。羅比以獨立人士登記。一個舊臉孔回歸。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #1
programme.desc: 在眼鏡蛇道場贏得18歲以下全谷空手道錦標賽冠軍後,強尼開始質疑自己的道場哲學,並與他一位故人打交道。丹尼爾尋找正確的方式來應付眼鏡蛇道場的統治。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #1
programme.desc: 在眼鏡蛇道場贏得18歲以下全谷空手道錦標賽冠軍後,強尼開始質疑自己的道場哲學,並與他一位故人打交道。丹尼爾尋找正確的方式來應付眼鏡蛇道場的統治。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #2
programme.desc: 丹尼爾開始教導第一批空手道學生,他懷疑自己是否能接替宮城先生的衣缽。在一個意想不到的來源幫助下,強尼發明了一些邪道訓練方法。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #3
programme.desc: 丹尼爾全力以赴為宮城道招募新生。強尼反省生命中一些重要的關係,並以自己的方式回應丹尼爾的努力宣傳。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #4
programme.desc: 丹尼爾再次嘗試推廣宮城道,並以熟悉的方式獲得指導。強尼對克里斯的背景越發生疑。一名新的眼鏡蛇道場學生挑戰米格爾並與艾莎成為朋友,而羅比則重溫寧願忘記的過去。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #5
programme.desc: 丹尼爾努力幫助新生學習。米格爾交了新友,而強尼則嘗試修復一段關係。兩個道場之間的張力已達到臨界點。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #6
programme.desc: 丹尼爾的學生們上了如何克服怨恨的一課。強尼離開道場一段時間,而克里斯則發揮他的影響力。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #7
programme.desc: 為了讓學生們做好準備,丹尼爾嘗試一些新的訓練方法。米格爾活學活用。強尼做出一個影響眼鏡蛇道場既艱難但關鍵的決定。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #8
programme.desc: 丹尼爾努力與阿曼達修補關係,而強尼則打開約會應用程式的大門。米格爾、薩曼莎、羅比和朵利的相遇讓事情變得複雜起來。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #9
programme.desc: 強尼小心翼翼地嘗試不大會成功的戀愛,而丹尼爾和阿曼達則享受浪漫的約會夜。嘗試讓兩個道場的學生聚會卻適得其反,青少年間的敵意不斷升級。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #10
programme.desc: 這是西谷高中開學的第一天,但​​兩個道場之間的張力並沒有隨著夏天的結束而緩和。丹尼爾和強尼之間的競爭到了白熱化階段。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #1
programme.desc: 米格爾命懸一線,羅比失蹤。丹尼爾與強尼名譽掃地,社區仍為「西谷高中大亂鬥」的後續動盪不安。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #2
programme.desc: 丹尼爾與強尼放下成見,聯手尋找羅比。米格爾的康復之路充滿未知,克里斯試圖召回托莉重返道館。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #3
programme.desc: 丹尼爾的事業因形象受損而陷入低潮,並收到收購提議;強尼四處籌錢,為米格爾的手術奔走。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #4
programme.desc: 丹尼爾前往日本洽談重要會議,重回沖繩,尋找能讓事業與人生重回正軌的啟示。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #5
programme.desc: 在沖繩,丹尼爾重逢舊友與舊敵,意外獲得新的領悟。同時,兩大道館的宿怨持續升溫。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #6
programme.desc: 米格爾幫助強尼打造完美的社交媒體形象;克里斯積極招募新成員,丹尼爾與阿曼達試圖關閉眼鏡蛇道館。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #7
programme.desc: 丹尼爾陪伴受創的珊,修復父女關係。強尼計劃成立新道館,卻苦於想不到一個酷炫的名字。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #8
programme.desc: 得知本年度全谷空手道大賽被取消後,三位師父齊聚市議會,努力爭取比賽繼續舉行。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #9
programme.desc: 聖誕節將至,愛情與和解的氣息瀰漫。丹尼爾與米格爾找到共同點,眼鏡蛇學徒展開一場秘密行動。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #10
programme.desc: 聖誕派對上舊傷復發、恩怨再起。克里斯的學生發動暴力襲擊,新的背叛與同盟由此誕生。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #1
programme.desc: 強尼與丹尼爾合併道館,但彼此截然不同的教學風格立刻產生衝突。克里斯試圖說服一名前搭檔重返眼鏡蛇道館。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #2
programme.desc: 強尼學習防守策略,丹尼爾則嘗試主動進攻。阿曼達直面托莉。新來的肯尼在學校遭到霸凌。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #3
programme.desc: 在羅比的鼓勵下,肯尼試圖成為眼鏡蛇道館的學生;同時,強尼鼓勵珊相信自己,勇敢踏出一步。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #4
programme.desc: 克里斯將泰瑞帶回眼鏡蛇道館,但這位舊夥伴並不想重蹈覆轍。強尼對丹尼爾指導米格爾感到心生嫉妒。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #5
programme.desc: 當強尼與丹尼爾同意進行一場「勝者全拿」的師父對決時,他們的道館——以及脆弱的同盟——瀕臨瓦解。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #6
programme.desc: 即將到來的比賽規則出現重大變動,強尼急忙為「鷹牙道館」尋找新學員。托莉不得不向拉魯索一家請求幫助。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #7
programme.desc: 丹尼爾邀請安東尼加入宮城道,卻發現自己其實並不如想像中了解兒子。米格爾得知強尼與卡門之間的真相。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #8
programme.desc: 米格爾與珊期待參加青少年舞會,卻因另一對情侶的突然出現而生變。泰瑞將強尼引誘至一個熟悉的地方。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #9
programme.desc: 一年一度的全谷空手道大賽正式展開,多個道館為總冠軍而戰,同時清算私人恩怨。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #10
programme.desc: 比賽以震撼結局落幕,後續影響讓所有參賽者措手不及,兩位冠軍的未來充滿變數。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #1
programme.desc: 丹尼爾的新盟友(後轉為室友)考驗著阿曼達的耐心。米格爾在墨西哥尋找親生父親。泰瑞則開始對「眼鏡蛇道館」進行大改造。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #2
programme.desc: 喬善和丹尼爾策劃了一個針對泰瑞的冒險計畫。在墨西哥,羅比和強尼正在尋找米格爾,而米格爾發現了關於他父親的真相。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #3
programme.desc: 丹尼爾過去的另一個敵人重新浮出水面。經過一天的 SPA 水療和一番內心掙扎後,珊對於她與米格爾的未來做出了決定。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #4
programme.desc: 強尼和卡門的情事進展順利,而丹尼爾和阿曼達則被泰瑞的陰謀搞得心神不寧。青少年們的恩怨延燒到了水上樂園。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #5
programme.desc: 丹尼爾依靠一位朋友——也是「亦敵亦友」的夥伴。米格爾和羅比的緊張關係達到頂點。一張熟悉的面孔回歸了。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #6
programme.desc: 泰瑞招募了一位精通「拳法之道」的專家。丹尼爾選擇遠離紛爭,強尼和喬善卻主動挑起戰火。在監獄裡,克里斯正視著內心的心魔。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #7
programme.desc: 泰瑞和金發起了一項殘酷的挑戰,而喬善則教導他的學生們不同的一課。強尼和丹尼爾要求克里斯給出交代。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #8
programme.desc: 一個爭奪國際頂尖賽事名額的機會引發了道館間的激戰。多莉的忠誠度受到考驗。珊則難以放下米格爾。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #9
programme.desc: 多莉為她的反抗付出了代價。魟魚正與他的良知搏鬥。強尼、丹尼爾和喬善在城裡的慶祝之夜發生了意外轉折。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #10
programme.desc: 山谷區爆發了一場決戰之夜,強尼、丹尼爾、喬善和他們的學生們集結了所有的技能與力量,誓要揭發並擊垮泰瑞。

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #1
programme.desc: 強尼勞倫斯在輸掉全谷空手道錦標賽34年後,決定重開眼鏡蛇道場,而他學校的對手丹尼爾拉魯索則經營著一家成功的汽車公司。

programme.desc: 一次訓練事故後,關於女性是否應該被允許成為太空人的全國性辯論爆發。迪克·斯雷頓為該計劃辯護,並在未經美國宇航局官員許可的情況下公開宣布了首批女宇航員名單。為了讓第一位登上月球的美國女性讓路,戈爾多史蒂文斯被從阿波羅15號任務中除名。月球衛星影像顯示可能存在水,這對於計劃中的美國月球基地至關重要;下一次阿波羅任務的任務被重新分配,以尋找水源。艾倫·韋弗利和她的朋友、美國宇航局的技術員拉里·威爾遜分享了一個秘密。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #12
programme.desc: 決定向山田告白的茜將自己的決心告訴親友桃子和「琉璃姬」瑛太。茜無預警地來到山田的公寓,但面對急著要去補習班的山田,她始終無法說出心中的話。於是兩人約在補習班結束後再碰面,但突如其來的暴雨和椿衝動的行為讓當天的計畫被迫取消。

programme.title: 成為名留青史的壞女人吧 #3
programme.desc: 在女性向遊戲中本該對反派千金冷感的杜克,卻莫名地對艾莉西亞這位想留名歷史的反派表露興趣。艾莉西亞雖然對他的舉動感到困惑,但沒有閒暇沉溺於戀愛的她,悄悄潛入了魔法學院。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #11
programme.desc: 眼看圭護的運動鞋就要被搶走時監志出手幫助了他。襲擊圭護的男人利用了具有興奮作用的珠珠糖增強自己的力量及欲望。據說散播珠珠糖的是人稱「狼」的人物,而使用珠珠糖作亂的那些人則被稱為「狗」。另一方面,自稱是魔女的宮尾音夢出現在妮可和守仁面前。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第四季) #2
programme.desc: 離春高全國大賽僅剩一個月。擅自參加宮城縣1年級生選拔強化集訓的日向以撿球員的身分加入。此時白鳥澤3年級生的畢業生作為練習賽的對手來訪。

programme.title: 成為名留青史的壞女人吧 #3
programme.desc: 在女性向遊戲中本該對反派千金冷感的杜克,卻莫名地對艾莉西亞這位想留名歷史的反派表露興趣。艾莉西亞雖然對他的舉動感到困惑,但沒有閒暇沉溺於戀愛的她,悄悄潛入了魔法學院。

programme.title: 成為名留青史的壞女人吧 #4
programme.desc: 艾莉西亞因為卓越的能力得到器重,於是接下負責監督聖女麗茲的任務,艾莉西亞因此得到「聖女的宿敵」這個對反派千金而言最完美的身分。她以特例進入麗茲所在的魔法學院就讀,那裡卻是敵人的大本營。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #13
programme.desc: 一連串風波落幕後,真神圭護搬入乙木家。根據圭護的說法,他只要看到「彎月形狀的東西」就會變成狼人,任性妄為地沉溺於食慾及睡眠,甚至連性慾都會變得無所限制。為了降低他變身的風險,妮可、守仁、監志和圭護合力將家裡所有彎月形狀的東西都收了起來。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #14
programme.desc: 本集A part播出「混亂的海市蜃樓」第119話「討伐FUZZY-4」。空、朧、狹霧、薩克來到了過去曾進行某種研究的廢棄大樓。薩克和狹霧讓身為新人的空和朧待命,並分別潛入東棟和西棟。然而朧卻反抗薩克。這時,敵人的身影突然出現!

programme.title: 海賊王女 #5
programme.desc: 透過在利巴爾奥伯施泰因得到的情報,一行人抵達神秘石頭採掘地「奧爾良」。菲娜在迷宮般的採掘場受陌生記憶的引導,往深處前行。面對氛圍變化極大的她,雪丸雖然感到疑惑但仍跟了上去。此時眾人以為有在巴爾巴拉爾甩掉的海賊團卻從他們身後悄悄逼近。

programme.title: 海賊王女 #6
programme.desc: 被關在採掘場的雪丸等人試圖逃脫,追上遭火爆玫瑰抓住的菲娜。而菲娜被帶往阿貝爾率領的英國海兵隊軍船。阿貝爾將她帶到客房後講述了哥布林劍士以及菲娜母親的事,她同時也得知武士們真正的目的。

programme.title: 海賊王女 #7
programme.desc: 為了救出菲娜,雪丸隻身一人從鰹魚2號離開。武士們苦於在島嶼紀律和菲娜之間做出抉擇,猶豫該從命返航回島上或打破紀律,作為海賊活下去。此時火爆玫瑰襲擊藍巨靈,冉冉升起的黑煙喚醒了菲娜本已忘卻的記憶。

programme.title: 海賊王女 #8
programme.desc: 武士們將菲娜從藍巨靈成功帶回來,雪丸卻在過程中受了重傷,為了治療他的傷勢,一行人在紗富彎街稍作停留。紫檀將菲娜稱作魔女後便離開。菲娜看到夥伴因自己而互相對立,開始煩惱是否該繼續旅行。

programme.title: 海賊王 #486
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #10
programme.desc: 在茜因為嚴重的感冒差點倒下時,出現在她面前的山田把她送到診所看病。椿曾在另一款網路遊戲中與山田對戰,與他建立友誼。了解山田會與女性保持距離的椿儘管心中排斥喜歡上對方,但對他的感情卻逐漸變得深厚,山田在她心中的地位也日益增大。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #11
programme.desc: 在山田的照顧下茜從感冒中康復。久違地登入FOS後,她第一次與公會新成員椿的角色接觸。兩人組隊挑戰了最終頭目,但卻因為敵人防禦力太高而陷入困境,不過一同戰鬥的過程讓茜與椿的關係立刻變得親近。登出後茜打給山田,希望能獲得有關遊戲攻略的建議。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #12
programme.desc: 決定向山田告白的茜將自己的決心告訴親友桃子和「琉璃姬」瑛太。茜無預警地來到山田的公寓,但面對急著要去補習班的山田,她始終無法說出心中的話。於是兩人約在補習班結束後再碰面,但突如其來的暴雨和椿衝動的行為讓當天的計畫被迫取消。

programme.title: 成為名留青史的壞女人吧 #3
programme.desc: 在女性向遊戲中本該對反派千金冷感的杜克,卻莫名地對艾莉西亞這位想留名歷史的反派表露興趣。艾莉西亞雖然對他的舉動感到困惑,但沒有閒暇沉溺於戀愛的她,悄悄潛入了魔法學院。

programme.title: 成為名留青史的壞女人吧 #4
programme.desc: 艾莉西亞因為卓越的能力得到器重,於是接下負責監督聖女麗茲的任務,艾莉西亞因此得到「聖女的宿敵」這個對反派千金而言最完美的身分。她以特例進入麗茲所在的魔法學院就讀,那裡卻是敵人的大本營。

programme.title: 海賊王 #486
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第三季) #8
programme.desc: 月島帶傷下場,由成田替補。烏野跟白鳥澤繼續纏鬥到搶分,眼見白鳥澤只要再得一分比賽就結束了。繫心教練一句大喊喚醒了眾人的鬥志。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第三季) #9
programme.desc: 第五局的局末點,同分。月島在這時候回到場上,兩隊又繼續廝殺。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第三季) #10
programme.desc: 最后局终于打到了20分。两支球队都有不同的战斗理念。他们中的哪一个会赢?

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第四季) #1
programme.desc: 烏野高中排球社逐步進行全國大賽的準備,影山和月島分別收到全日本青年強化集訓與宮城縣1年級生選拔強化集訓的召集消息。沒被選中的日向則擅自參加後者的集訓。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第四季) #2
programme.desc: 離春高全國大賽僅剩一個月。擅自參加宮城縣1年級生選拔強化集訓的日向以撿球員的身分加入。此時白鳥澤3年級生的畢業生作為練習賽的對手來訪。

programme.title: 家裡蹲吸血姬的鬱悶 #5
programme.desc: 由於烈核解放,可瑪莉擊退了米莉桑德,卻喪失一切記憶,仍然對自己的強大實力毫無自覺。這時可瑪莉巧遇七紅天之一的芙萊特,當場發生衝突。之後皇帝下令可瑪莉擊退恐怖分子,而被選為她的搭檔的,是明明身為七紅天,卻內向又嬌弱的少女——佐久奈!

programme.title: 家裡蹲吸血姬的鬱悶 #6
programme.desc: 為了判定可瑪莉配不配當七紅天,召開了七紅天會議。芙萊特懷疑可瑪莉的實力,抓到機會就開口攻擊,可瑪莉反嗆回去,會議現場一片混亂。暴怒的芙萊特正式向可瑪莉宣戰,但是武鬥派的奧迪隆竟乾脆提議直接舉辦七紅天互相廝殺的「七紅天爭霸戰」!

programme.title: 家裡蹲吸血姬的鬱悶 #7
programme.desc: 可瑪莉與佐久奈聯手參戰七紅天爭霸戰 ,但是佐久奈其實是「逆月」的間諜。她的家人被組織抓去當人質。佐久奈為了找出解決方法,找米莉桑德商量。七紅天爭霸戰一開始,可瑪莉的部下就受到挑釁,全員突襲芙萊特的部隊,迪普涅卻趁這時向可瑪莉發起猛攻!

programme.title: 家裡蹲吸血姬的鬱悶 #8
programme.desc: 可瑪莉發動了烈核解放,讓七紅天爭霸戰一口氣進入尾聲。戰場崩毀,還站在舞台的人只剩下可瑪莉和佐久奈。由於佐久奈的精神魔法「心識回讀」,可瑪莉透過佐久奈的記憶得知了她真正的力量以及過去。正當兩人想和解時,留在戰場上的最後一人突然現身。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #10
programme.desc: 在茜因為嚴重的感冒差點倒下時,出現在她面前的山田把她送到診所看病。椿曾在另一款網路遊戲中與山田對戰,與他建立友誼。了解山田會與女性保持距離的椿儘管心中排斥喜歡上對方,但對他的感情卻逐漸變得深厚,山田在她心中的地位也日益增大。

programme.title: 和山田談場LV999的戀愛 #11
programme.desc: 在山田的照顧下茜從感冒中康復。久違地登入FOS後,她第一次與公會新成員椿的角色接觸。兩人組隊挑戰了最終頭目,但卻因為敵人防禦力太高而陷入困境,不過一同戰鬥的過程讓茜與椿的關係立刻變得親近。登出後茜打給山田,希望能獲得有關遊戲攻略的建議。

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#67粵
programme.desc: 溢看戲時與妄顧公德的惡霸爭論，反被惡霸以歪理迫她道歉。但此事卻被拍成短片放於網上，溢訴苦，朋教溢向慶學「人善人欺天不欺」。溢到遊戲中心找尋慶，但溢竟又再遇上惡人，這次慶替他挺身而出，最終成功趕走惡霸。

programme.title: 尚食#7粵普
programme.desc: 漢王看到游一帆拜祭亡母，認出他是失蹤多年之子。胡善圍扭傷腳，唯有子衿願去送飯，令其對子衿頗為欣賞，願加以提攜。王遙清收月華為徒，兩人一起完善失傳古譜。紫萍在寒風中跪地一夜，終令孟尚食答應讓她再入庖廚。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 主持們登上小艇，享用「避風塘」招牌炒肉蟹、炒蜆美食，鼎爺還提起避風塘上的第一次約會。鼎爺購入一隻大龍蝦，起殼後要阿譚將龍蝦殼及蝦殼一起熬煮，做出濃蝦湯來炒伊麵。備用的龍蝦肉則連同荷蘭豆、百合、白玉木耳等配菜一起爆炒，鑊氣十足！二人另到果園摘香蕉，暢談香蕉適宜食用的時機。返回廚房，沒有蕉葉，轉用荷葉鋪上蒸籠，巧製一道「荷葉粉蒸肉」。阿譚想採用糯米粉替代炒勻糯米及粘米，卻未為拍檔接受，有何原因？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 癌症骨轉移是指癌細胞由其他組織擴散至骨骼，常見於乳癌、肺癌與前列腺癌。臨床腫瘤科醫生提到這病或會引致病理性骨折等併發症，並詳析治標與治本的治療方案。逆境智商(AQ)是衡量人的抗壓與復原能力，精神科醫生以汽車零件作比喻，形象化解說IQ、EQ與AQ之別， AQ高的孩子普遍能較樂觀地面對困難。嘉賓亦帶來提升AQ四部曲，還建議家長透過遊戲、故事討論協助孩子訓練。「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨師傅炮製「香葉三杯蝦」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 祖藍漫步汕頭的商業區，與香港的中環氣氛大不同，同時亦蘊藏了一些當地特色美食。有雪糕店旨在創出新穎口味，以鴨屎香呈現汕頭獨有的雪糕味道之餘，另一款加入苦瓜的雪糕更是得獎之作！祖藍常讚汕頭牛好味，用新鮮牛肉造成漢堡扒，再以鹹菜代替酸瓜，製作出汕頭特色漢堡，既前衛又不覺味道奇怪；還有一款魷魚漢堡？汕頭有餐廳熬製雞煲湯底時分別加入百香果、木薑子，零舍開胃！店主更推介一款「糯米烤雞」，最不能錯過的是雞皮？

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#19粵PG
programme.desc: 司徒邦送司徒嵐玉珮，表示愛她的人永遠守護她。曉盈帶助手到鼎福和上班，一班員工有意刁難，但曉盈有備而來。秀瓊分別送紅酒和下酒食物給竇彰與德正，盼兩父子和好。兆明得知曉盈被中介商瞞騙，購入過期黃豆。曉盈抱怨威龍千方百計阻止她收購鼎福和，威龍反拿出鑽石戒指求婚……司徒嵐埋首會計工作，兆明傳短訊逗她開心。司徒嵐被兆明的經歷感動，但對他仍然沒有感覺，決定離開他。秀瓊對司徒嵐不再寫小說、結束咖啡店深感不安……

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: 壯五拿著資料去遊說環讓他回家，環最終放行。ZOOL上去《Next Re:vale》做嘉賓，前半段一言不發，虎於企圖用筆嚇千卻被百反制，四人屈服配合節目進行，事後百把電話號碼交給對方。壯五回到家裡，與父親對峙。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「WORKOUT 2GETHER」再次展開，Ban Sir率先帶領大家進行基礎體適能訓練。他指出，這些動作能有效提升協調、反應與速度，不僅有助日常運動表現，對做家務、行樓梯亦大有裨益。此外，小朋友亦可透過踢腿、交叉步等動作，增強平衡力與下肢肌肉。節目還會播出AI生成動畫《星星的銀幣》的下半部份，大家也要學習故事內小女孩的無私愛心，向身邊人傳遞溫暖和關懷。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 同學七海拾到一個星光兔的袋子，走來詢問陽葵是否她的，就在這時，另一位同學鈴夢則說這個袋子是她妹妹的，還強調自己身為模特兒對星光兔沒興趣。儘管如此，陽葵還是想和鈴夢交朋友，二人更開始熟絡起來……

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 糖尿病是常見的都市病，在西方國家很普通，越來越多香港人亦患上此病，部分人甚至不知道已患上糖尿病，其實糖尿病就是人體的胰臟，不能分泌足夠的胰島素，或者胰島素失去應有的功能，新聞掏寶和大家重溫1991年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 報料觀眾的父親去年九月離世，他打算終止父親名下的電話服務，怎料與電訊商多次交涉仍不果，更被指累積欠費多達五千元……多間寵物用品店都有出售海外品牌的寵物飼料，眾店主卻遭指控侵權，原因是相關品牌的商標早已被人在港註冊。法院審訊後，店主們被裁定要繳付逾五百萬賠償。然而經追查發現，入稟者僅註冊商標，並無生產貨品，令所謂侵權指控受質疑。有銀行推出為未滿十八歲青少年而設的理財計劃，希望助他們及早適當管理財富。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2777粵
programme.desc: 敢威、尚善與力蓮碰巧同時休假，無法聯絡得上。某項目臨時改為公開招標，作為最高決策人的璟風遂召集相關人員商議可要調整標價，卻未有定論，幸有人想到拖延之策。為免再出現高層真空狀況，璟風建議預早請假並互通消息，獲敢威同意。敢威打算兩星期後乘郵輪度假，怎料力蓮、尚善已申請休假，還似乎勢在必行，他只好取消行程，家聰卻提出另類解決方案。敢威對主管及以上級別推行新請假政策，意圖阻止力蓮休假，卻引發不少問題……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#4粵PG
programme.desc: 「離島三害案」尋回的兇器上，證實還有卓飛的DNA。惠知打算調查「第四名疑犯」卓飛的去向，並要求邵玲幫忙，終發現驚人內情。回到庭上，在惠知與檢控官林雅晴的追問下，最終揭出案件的殘酷真相！惠知藉判詞指出家長盲目包庇，令犯罪少年一錯再錯，淑樺聽出其用意，心情鬱悶。光正之女邱天雪，希望促成父親與惠知和好，卻事與願違。淑樺接到保鏢通知，指成彬不知去向，令淑樺大為緊張……

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：機智女法醫2#21粵普PG
programme.desc: 冷月帶著藥材來交州支援楚楚，並幫忙用止痛粉替病人去掉壁蝨，楚楚從中得到啟發，決定剖腹取蟲。祐辰安在兩國和談上設局刺殺祐龍晟，又用藥使南趙王病重，趁機代理朝政。得知藥材不足，楚父便動身前往山貨市集採買。

programme.title: Towngas Mia Cucina 呈獻：轟炸味蕾的廚房粵
programme.desc: 在四川，臘肉會加甚麼香料醃製？當地人還會故意把臘肉燒到變焦，再刮走表面燒焦一層，所為何事？世韜師傅概述四川臘肉與廣式臘肉之別，隨後用不同臘肉、臘腸炮製「四川臘味煲仔飯」；臘味頭頭尾尾亦不浪費，連同冰糖、生抽、老抽來煮出煲仔飯豉油，絕對夠美味！遼寧本溪有過百間賣烤豆皮的店舖，食材廉價簡單，濃味好吃的背後卻是工序多多！人氣女主廚紫欣教觀眾在家輕鬆「複製」，奉上「煙燻烤豆皮」，但對祖儀來說似乎不易……

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#37粵
programme.desc: 嫪毐以嬴政身世秘密要脅他確保一家三口安全。廷芳心緒不寧，排舞錯漏百出，少龍教她跳西班牙舞，二人關係轉好。廷芳在齊王面前表演後，突然有殺手跳出刺殺齊王，劍劃過廷芳的背。廷芳自知中毒垂危，向少龍剖白愛意，少龍承諾待她復元後娶她。少龍推測齊相田單籌劃刺殺行動，與善柔夜探田府，揭穿主公是齊墨鉅子曹秋道，秋道以善柔性命及解藥交換鉅子令秘笈。嫪毐與嬴政探望朱姬，嬴政的態度和善，原來嫪毐找來假嬴政密謀頂包秦王。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 報料觀眾的父親去年九月離世，他打算終止父親名下的電話服務，怎料與電訊商多次交涉仍不果，更被指累積欠費多達五千元……多間寵物用品店都有出售海外品牌的寵物飼料，眾店主卻遭指控侵權，原因是相關品牌的商標早已被人在港註冊。法院審訊後，店主們被裁定要繳付逾五百萬賠償。然而經追查發現，入稟者僅註冊商標，並無生產貨品，令所謂侵權指控受質疑。有銀行推出為未滿十八歲青少年而設的理財計劃，希望助他們及早適當管理財富。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 癌症骨轉移是指癌細胞由其他組織擴散至骨骼，常見於乳癌、肺癌與前列腺癌。臨床腫瘤科醫生提到這病或會引致病理性骨折等併發症，並詳析治標與治本的治療方案。逆境智商(AQ)是衡量人的抗壓與復原能力，精神科醫生以汽車零件作比喻，形象化解說IQ、EQ與AQ之別， AQ高的孩子普遍能較樂觀地面對困難。嘉賓亦帶來提升AQ四部曲，還建議家長透過遊戲、故事討論協助孩子訓練。「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨師傅炮製「香葉三杯蝦」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 祖藍漫步汕頭的商業區，與香港的中環氣氛大不同，同時亦蘊藏了一些當地特色美食。有雪糕店旨在創出新穎口味，以鴨屎香呈現汕頭獨有的雪糕味道之餘，另一款加入苦瓜的雪糕更是得獎之作！祖藍常讚汕頭牛好味，用新鮮牛肉造成漢堡扒，再以鹹菜代替酸瓜，製作出汕頭特色漢堡，既前衛又不覺味道奇怪；還有一款魷魚漢堡？汕頭有餐廳熬製雞煲湯底時分別加入百香果、木薑子，零舍開胃！店主更推介一款「糯米烤雞」，最不能錯過的是雞皮？

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#19粵PG
programme.desc: 司徒邦送司徒嵐玉珮，表示愛她的人永遠守護她。曉盈帶助手到鼎福和上班，一班員工有意刁難，但曉盈有備而來。秀瓊分別送紅酒和下酒食物給竇彰與德正，盼兩父子和好。兆明得知曉盈被中介商瞞騙，購入過期黃豆。曉盈抱怨威龍千方百計阻止她收購鼎福和，威龍反拿出鑽石戒指求婚……司徒嵐埋首會計工作，兆明傳短訊逗她開心。司徒嵐被兆明的經歷感動，但對他仍然沒有感覺，決定離開他。秀瓊對司徒嵐不再寫小說、結束咖啡店深感不安……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#67粵
programme.desc: 溢看戲時與妄顧公德的惡霸爭論，反被惡霸以歪理迫她道歉。但此事卻被拍成短片放於網上，溢訴苦，朋教溢向慶學「人善人欺天不欺」。溢到遊戲中心找尋慶，但溢竟又再遇上惡人，這次慶替他挺身而出，最終成功趕走惡霸。

programme.title: 尚食#7粵普
programme.desc: 漢王看到游一帆拜祭亡母，認出他是失蹤多年之子。胡善圍扭傷腳，唯有子衿願去送飯，令其對子衿頗為欣賞，願加以提攜。王遙清收月華為徒，兩人一起完善失傳古譜。紫萍在寒風中跪地一夜，終令孟尚食答應讓她再入庖廚。

programme.title: 大玩特玩粵
programme.desc: 壓軸一玩，在婚宴場地玩一番，由「垃圾之最」連詩雅、朱智賢鬥倒霉抽隊員，兩人的行為總是令人摸不著頭腦。大玩隊與特玩隊進行一對一單挑，蝦頭與楊潮凱造就「同姓一吻」；陳嘉桓、林秀怡竟出動肥肉搶鏡；翟威廉與朱智賢大鬥反應，威廉勝出卻輸風度！「開口中」遊戲談起情侶間的暱稱，眾人戀情被Bob擺上檯，為何最後區永權要接受吃辣飯的懲罰？藝員搶花球爭獎品，有甚麼東西令蝦頭感動流涕？慰勞宴上，眾人分享最難忘的事。

programme.title: 同屋企人去旅行粵
programme.desc: 關楓馨首次單獨和爸爸關禮傑去旅行，安排了海景酒店，希望可一起看日出。兩人先挑戰揚帆出海，父女合作操控風帆，漸見默契。楓馨又帶爸爸夜遊惠州年輕人蒲點，嘗試夾公仔，也換上泳裝享受溫泉樂。翌日享用早餐後，父女登高觀賞雙月灣美景，還駕駛越野車漫遊沙灘。楓馨特意為爸爸準備內地網紅最新的打卡活動— 圍爐煮茶，兩人互相替對方拍照，傑爸的攝影姿勢與技術卻似乎被嫌棄！入夜，父女摸着酒杯深入對談，楓馨緣何觸動落淚？

programme.title: 同屋企人去旅行粵
programme.desc: 楓馨偕爸爸獨遊，擔心媽媽會呷醋，因此親自調製香水送贈母親「補飛」。及後和爸爸會合吃飯，楓馨還溫馨餵他進食。關氏父女接着以高卡車競速分勝負，完賽後談感受，傑哥一份感動湧上心頭，所為何事？來到惠州的海鮮街大擦一頓，父女互相點菜許諾回家後為對方下廚。惠州之行臨近尾聲，楓馨要求爸爸為她策劃的這次旅程評分，竟只得八十分？父女兩人又會訴說對這趟旅程的感受、得着，傑哥還暗中為女兒準備了一份窩心禮物，會是甚麼？

programme.title: 高朋滿座#68粵
programme.desc: 情進入義的公司後，兄妹感情大進。義一反懶惰本性，教授她辦公室生存之道。義將德下屬德安解僱，情竟將有義視為機密的「公司人物關係表」送給德安。義大怒，指責有情專門與他作對，有情反唇相譏，兩兄妹竟因此吵翻。

programme.title: 尚食#8粵普
programme.desc: 子衿勸說朱瞻基原諒太孫妃，不料二人誤會更深，朱瞻基對子衿發洩怨氣，子衿決定以奴婢對待主人的方式待之。朱瞻基等人品鑒尚食局為外國使節團準備的菜品，有別於其他人呈上各樣山珍海味，子衿偏偏呈上尋常食物。

programme.title: 香港本色粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 金雕、玉雕、牙雕已成夕陽行業，一班手藝非凡的老師傅，如何為這些傳統工藝「守尾門」？一塊金磚，由熔金到打磨，每個步驟都要一絲不苟，打金師傅胡文楷卻稱學習了「批、鑲、卓、鑿」已稱得上滿師，但要怎樣才能獨當一面？經過師傅悉心設計，一塊石頭，隨時會變成價值連成的寶玉！何以香蕉、燒肉、龍蝦等亦能成為精緻的玉器擺設？牙雕業在國際實施象牙禁運後面臨重大衝擊，何以朱忠盛仍堅持守護這門即將絕跡的手藝？

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 鼎爺與阿譚到塔門與漁民捉海鮮，有甚麼收穫？接着鼎爺以海膽蒸蛋白及炒飯，將原片海膽與蛋白同蒸，想蛋白蒸起來更幼滑有何秘訣？鼎爺製作炒飯時特意選用蛋白帶出海膽的鮮味，為何海膽要分兩次下鑊？鼎爺與阿譚品嚐過塔門住家菜，再帶來兩道海鮮菜式。先炮製「鮑魚綠豆沙」，這道「豪華」糖水有何來歷？糖水中的「西米棟楝」是甚麼？鼎爺又以荷包魷切幼絲，配搭蝦醬、蔬菜炒麵，留意下材料的先後次序，令魷魚嫩滑不致韌。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 老花是眼睛自然退化的現象，難以躲避，故應學懂好好應對處理。近視與老花，會互相抵消嗎？眼科醫生建議選用老花漸進鏡或老花隱形眼鏡，如未能適應，也有兩個主要手術方案可供選擇，詳情如何？跟復活節相關之物，如兔子、復活蛋、紅蘿蔔，都可成為復活節特別造型甜品的題材。五星級酒店糕餅總廚展示作品之餘，還會即席示範「復活節榛果朱古力慕絲盆栽」的製作步驟。至於「睇餸食飯」，Annie師傅烹調一道「蝦子腐皮素雞」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 有三兄弟繼承了父親的砂鍋粥路邊攤，發展成砂鍋粥店，更標明即點即煮即宰。粥內有肉蟹、鮑魚、蟶子，足料非常，也滿載鮮味；椒鹽鷓鴣等伴粥小菜亦不容錯過！踏進小吃街，祖藍又有任務了！買齊反沙番薯芋、無米粿、鱟粿、橄欖油甘甘蔗汁、酸菜豬肚湯五種小食，認識小吃歷史之外，還找來小朋友為他現場即學的潮汕話評分呢！祖藍接着到步行街逛夜市，順道為家中三位女士搜羅禮物，有檔主專誠為祖藍兩位千金設計簡單名牌，不得不買啦！

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#20粵PG
programme.desc: (大結局)竇彰盼曉盈將五成半股權賣回給竇家，讓他們延續傳統精神。百喜昇受醜聞影響，股價不斷下跌。司徒嵐忽然記起《哥士的殺手》故事內容及意外情景，頭痛不已。秀瓊認錯鄰家是自己的家，兆明提議她做檢查。蔣生要曉盈對鼎福和事件負全責，並將鼎福和的股份全賣回竇家。竇彰邀同業加入鼎福和，各人表示愛莫能助……德正參加沙沙舞比賽被美娜奚落，仍堅持站在舞台，並找來丹丹做舞伴。兆明帶秀瓊看醫生，證實她患腦退化症……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子隨爸爸晚上巡區提高防火意識，事後到居酒屋小休，其間得以窺探成年人的世界。小玉不小心弄壞盛載其父母回憶的音樂盒，去鐘錶店找人修理但不果，小丸子提議她學習用鋼琴把曲子彈奏出來。

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: 壯五向父親說出內心想法，但後者不理，更借故誣陷環傷人，要脅壯五放棄演藝活動。壯五獨個兒主持電台節目，其間透露自己的過去，更播出TRIGGER的歌。環前來迎接壯五，在車上告訴他其父親已答允請求。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 復活節有甚麼象徵物件？導師在「Artspiration」教大家繪畫色彩繽紛的應節元素。畫紙右方有一個籃，用來盛起不同大小、顏色的復活蛋；至於左方及籃後，都可以畫出可愛得意、耳朵長長的復活兔。跟着導師的指引，繪畫過程相信會容易得多。如小朋友遇到一些困難的事情，經「開心SHARE」過後，說不定也可找到輕鬆面對的方法！主持們是怎樣克服數學功課與課堂作文的「難關」？Emily姐姐還試過以跳舞代替部份默書？

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 美月在早晨直播時，說起「想趁今年內做到的事」，陽葵希望自己的廚藝有所進步，而美月則想克服最害怕的跳箱。陽葵見狀，決定為美月進行特訓，可是美月仍然對跳箱充滿恐懼，怎麼都跳不過去……

programme.title: Kiki & Nuna 知識寶庫粵普
programme.desc: 在小鎮上生活著六個小朋友，在他們的日常生活中，會遇到形形色色的問題，有朋友之間的情感問題，有生活中的安全問題，有待人處事的行為規範，美妙世界的科學原理

programme.desc: 日出康城一個1,500平方呎單位，如何把中式古董收藏品，融入現代設計風格？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2778粵
programme.desc: 樹根生日將至，適逢他擔任金剛門掌門十周年，打算邀請各地分館門人參與壽宴。城安等人忙於安排各項事宜，卻知悉樹根任期將滿，快將退位，懷疑他大事舖張另有所圖。聯絡海外門人並不順利，樹根責怪眾人辦事不力。尚善託潮偉查得海外多間分館已結束，門人四散，眾人於是取消壽宴，改為自行慶祝。生日當天，樹根以為壽宴如期舉行，滿心期待，眾人只好設法補救。出於某些原因，樹根被困家中。得悉麻煩盡消，眾人欣喜之際卻另有發現……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#5粵PG
programme.desc: 惠知審理一宗盜竊案，被告竟是當日意外開槍擊斃麗慈的警員何偉迪……偉迪一直愧疚，終鼓起勇氣探望麗慈的遺孤芳芳，偉迪再向惠知探問案件真相。邵文的母親冼勵梅被指「碰瓷」扮撞車敲詐，而被告上法庭，邵文自覺顏面無存，勵梅卻毫無悔意！凍肉店發現初生嬰兒屍體，女店主的女兒麥珊珊被控殺嬰罪，珊珊卻堅持不說出嬰兒爸爸是誰，裁判官洪思義覺得另有內情。宇澤的忌日，惠知往現場拜祭時，與淑樺狹路相逢……

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：機智女法醫2#22粵普PG
programme.desc: 辰安派人抓走楚平以威逼楚楚前往南趙，進而迫使瑾瑜答應出使南趙重啟和談。瑾瑜見虛弱的南趙王完全受制於辰安，看出其想借大唐之力順利繼位之野心,便暗示藩王未死，無法強行冊封，另一邊廂瑾瑜又秘密約見李璋…

programme.title: Towngas Mia Cucina 呈獻：轟炸味蕾的廚房粵
programme.desc: 透過片段了解雲南傣族的孔雀宴後，小儀師傅嘗試以「焗爐燒腩仔」重現碳火烤肉的美味。她用焗爐烤出香脆外皮，還分享保持肉汁的秘訣，關鍵是一張紙巾。另邊廂，祖儀不僅向永權敬「流水酒」，還唱歌助興？雲南西雙版納盛產茶葉，以茶入饌更是當地特色。家鋌師傅借鑑煮出「茶燻秘製豉油雞」，以茶燻香氣轟炸主持們的味蕾！想不到只需茶葉、白米、砂糖三種材料，就可帶來滋味效果。此外，祖儀好學詢問生抽、豉油的分別，卻釀成笑話？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#38粵
programme.desc: 嬴政野心勃勃，計劃十年內一統六國。嬴政將剛離母體的嬰兒掐死。嫪毐怒然挾持嬴政欲殺他，嬴政與趙高雙雙跳崖。少龍突然心緒不寧，再見銅鏡中影像模糊。嫪毐將真正兒子交給朱姬，原來他早已調包嬰兒。不韋見嬴政與朱姬突然關係轉好，隱覺不妥。琴清得悉少龍無恙回來，飛奔往渡頭接他，見他與廷芳態度親暱，錯愕。少龍奇怪二女沒有酸風醋雨。少龍更衣入宮時，赫見嬴政暱藏房中。嬴政講出調包原委，滕翼來報指琴清被大王軟禁。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 老花是眼睛自然退化的現象，難以躲避，故應學懂好好應對處理。近視與老花，會互相抵消嗎？眼科醫生建議選用老花漸進鏡或老花隱形眼鏡，如未能適應，也有兩個主要手術方案可供選擇，詳情如何？跟復活節相關之物，如兔子、復活蛋、紅蘿蔔，都可成為復活節特別造型甜品的題材。五星級酒店糕餅總廚展示作品之餘，還會即席示範「復活節榛果朱古力慕絲盆栽」的製作步驟。至於「睇餸食飯」，Annie師傅烹調一道「蝦子腐皮素雞」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在汕頭粵
programme.desc: 有三兄弟繼承了父親的砂鍋粥路邊攤，發展成砂鍋粥店，更標明即點即煮即宰。粥內有肉蟹、鮑魚、蟶子，足料非常，也滿載鮮味；椒鹽鷓鴣等伴粥小菜亦不容錯過！踏進小吃街，祖藍又有任務了！買齊反沙番薯芋、無米粿、鱟粿、橄欖油甘甘蔗汁、酸菜豬肚湯五種小食，認識小吃歷史之外，還找來小朋友為他現場即學的潮汕話評分呢！祖藍接着到步行街逛夜市，順道為家中三位女士搜羅禮物，有檔主專誠為祖藍兩位千金設計簡單名牌，不得不買啦！

programme.title: 燦爛的外母#20粵PG
programme.desc: (大結局)竇彰盼曉盈將五成半股權賣回給竇家，讓他們延續傳統精神。百喜昇受醜聞影響，股價不斷下跌。司徒嵐忽然記起《哥士的殺手》故事內容及意外情景，頭痛不已。秀瓊認錯鄰家是自己的家，兆明提議她做檢查。蔣生要曉盈對鼎福和事件負全責，並將鼎福和的股份全賣回竇家。竇彰邀同業加入鼎福和，各人表示愛莫能助……德正參加沙沙舞比賽被美娜奚落，仍堅持站在舞台，並找來丹丹做舞伴。兆明帶秀瓊看醫生，證實她患腦退化症……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#68粵
programme.desc: 情進入義的公司後，兄妹感情大進。義一反懶惰本性，教授她辦公室生存之道。義將德下屬德安解僱，情竟將有義視為機密的「公司人物關係表」送給德安。義大怒，指責有情專門與他作對，有情反唇相譏，兩兄妹竟因此吵翻。

programme.title: 尚食#8粵普
programme.desc: 子衿勸說朱瞻基原諒太孫妃，不料二人誤會更深，朱瞻基對子衿發洩怨氣，子衿決定以奴婢對待主人的方式待之。朱瞻基等人品鑒尚食局為外國使節團準備的菜品，有別於其他人呈上各樣山珍海味，子衿偏偏呈上尋常食物。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 日日運動身體好，吳幸美竟教跆拳道學員「洗面盆學游泳」、「牀下底踢毽」？原來是為了講解「㜺鬼」歇後語。廣東道玉器街是香港七十年代的熱門「蒲點」，主持們到訪玉器店學習分辨玉器優劣，期間發現「玉器塗白漆－ 內中有寶」？農曆七月初七又叫「七姐節」、「乞巧節」，背後除了牛郎織女的深情故事，還另有文章！霓虹燈製作過程繁複，「楷師傅」三兩下手勢便做出「TVB光管」，果然是「半空中點燈－ 高招」！

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 「盂蘭節」是中國傳統的「鬼節」，善信自會備好各式祭品「做節」。眾主持前往餅店尋找「文化遺產」，幸美卻帶來探險裝備，可謂「抬棺材甩褲－ 失禮死人」。鄭寶鴻另會講解「拋三牲」、「散福」等習俗。洋服店老闆逾四十年來堅持手做西裝，功架十足堪稱「飛機上點燈－ 高明」。張惠雅還向老闆請教何謂「關公領」、「飛機領」，以及時下流行的西裝款式。「擔屎唔偷食」意指為人忠直老實，俗語背後原來隱藏自明朝流傳至今的誤解！

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 哇揚皮影偶戲除了是一種提供視覺享受的傳統表演藝術, 更是傳遞宗教及哲學訊息的媒界 哇揚戲偶分為以皮革製作的皮影偶及木頭製作的木偶, 全靠工匠的巧手以精湛的手藝為戲偶賦予生命, 才能成就精彩的哇揚皮影偶戲

programme.title: 翻生工程粵英
programme.desc: 工程師Rob Bell帶大家探討將廢棄結構轉變為未來建築背後的重大挑戰。

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 嘉欣歸隊同遊沙巴，敏之、高Ling獻吻歡迎好姊妹。下榻酒店前先玩尋人遊戲，三位主持根據照片線索，周圍尋找男導遊，誰可率先完成任務？傾盆大雨，無阻美女們探索亞庇文化村之行。學習釀造米酒期間，三人意外獲得蜜蜂的熱情招待……她們還會拿起鋸刀自製竹筒杯，又挑戰原始吹箭，有人竟一擊即中？見識過原住民在傳統彈床遊戲展現的驚人彈跳力，主持們亦要體驗一番。玩樂之後，三人享用海鮮大餐，一嚐另類的海鮮肉骨茶。

programme.title: 港產旅行團粵
programme.desc: 山系KOL誓要征服大帽山！登山之前，衍峰與祖儀、穎彤到川龍村舊式茶樓歎早茶，細嚐懷舊風味點心。醫飽肚，輕輕鬆鬆步上觀景台，居高臨下睇靚景。再往山頂尋找芒草、席地野餐，等待長夜星空，湯兆昇博士傳授拍攝壯麗「星流跡」貼士。衍峰、穎彤、淑雅緊接展開軍事要塞之旅，順道認識松林炮台、摩星嶺炮台、銀禧炮台等歷史故事。終站來到日落觀瀾亭，楊潮凱不忘替穎彤拍下夕陽醉影。衍峰、穎彤決戰室內競技遊戲，激鬥蓄勢待發！

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 邏輯是指推論與證明的思想過程，對哲學、數學、科學和語言學等領域都十分重要，谷主凱婷還以象形文字作為例子。谷主汛文、凱文均認為身在不同狀況會影響邏輯分析，已「做功課」的凱婷嘗試向拍檔解說演繹推理、歸納推理與類比推理的相關概念。凱婷又引述「為何要學習邏輯」的古希臘典故，詳情如何？她亦還準備了「燒腦」問題，結果拍檔汛文、凱文面對「BB級」題目亦未能過關。三人還會討論可怎樣訓練邏輯思維，為觀眾提供建議。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 一路前行粵普
programme.desc: 一部聚焦中國生態保護，綠色高品質發展的環保公益紀實節目。透過沉浸式觀察新時代環保議題，並邀請胡歌、劉濤、陳龍三位明星親身參與，共同完成一場綠色低碳生活的行動。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: 絞豬肉是香港人常用的食材之一，Gigi姐為大家帶來一道陳皮蓮藕餅，教授如何做到吃到蓮藕的口感而不頂牙的竅門。再加上陳皮，它獨特的香氣令口味更有層次。這次更選用了三十年以上的陳皮，令菜式變得更為矜貴。

programme.title: 成人教科書粵
programme.desc: 一男一女本地小朋友，分別與一位外籍小孩背對背坐下。大家只透過說話認識對方，對於這種交友模式，眾人感受如何？主持洪永城講出不同的地方，讓孩子們說出第一印象，原來不少小朋友都覺得日本人有禮貌。永城接着帶兩位港孩家訪俄羅斯小朋友，並一同享用俄式家常菜，吃後有甚麼感想？餐後，眾位小朋友換上俄國的節慶服飾，隨俄裔男士體驗當地傳統舞蹈。大家及後還會試玩俄國民間的孩童遊戲，這是一款拋擲木棒的競技，玩法怎樣？

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵PG
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神秘，我們會繼續從世界各地神秘事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 太晴趕回超鐵機，適性值恢復正常，並且請求出戰。伊奈召喚出大量UNKNOWN，太晴陷入苦戰之際，良太和茜及時趕到。太晴按照濱的指示發射光速能量炮，成功擊敗伊奈。三人和好如初，出戰三人四足。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 兒童體適能教練Ban Sir本集帶來伸展訓練，測試大家的柔軟度，箇中包括模仿受驚的貓咪、拍翼的蝴蝶等趣味動作，眾人表現如何？「WORKOUT 2GETHER」的另一組動作，是間歇性高強度的速度訓練，教練提到要達至輕微氣喘與冒汗才算合格。其間，現場小朋友與彤彤姐姐要聽從指令，迅速跳向不同方向，不僅考驗反應，更挑戰快速思考，結果偶爾出現失誤。「動物好萌友」環節，這次介紹擁有靈敏嗅覺與聽覺的法國垂耳兔。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子騎單車去三松屋購物，期間突然下雨，笹山撐傘送她回家，誰知隔天再去，單車已經不翼而飛。小丸子弄髒房間卻態度囂張，被媽媽罰負責打掃房間，為了減少工作量，她決定盡可能避免弄髒房間。

programme.title: 危機現場粵
programme.desc: 本片選取近年來國內最具代表性的安全事故和自然災害，作科學分析，重現處置過程，展現當下中國應急救援專業能力的提升和全新面貌，分析事發原因和調查過程，解讀事故隱患。同時，展示人類的勇氣、智慧與無畏。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 三、四月是畢業生求職黃金旺季，但對於部分應屆畢業生而言，就業前景卻未見樂觀。根據統計處資料，2025年第四季，20至24歲青年失業率達123%，較疫情時2021年同期的85%更高，年輕畢業生求職面對甚麼困難？根據大學聯校就業資料庫數據，針對大學生的全職職位空缺，由2021年第四季約15萬個，大跌逾五成至2025年同期約7,000個，創近年新低，為甚麼呢？青年就業困難如何反映世代焦慮？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 渣打優先私人理財呈獻：Grand住享樂人生粵
programme.desc: 健康就是財富，Grand活也要關注身心靈！人生就似馬拉松，陳山聰為全馬練習足足一年，如何堅持信念？高Ling坦言曾於迷惘期跟發哥跑步，獲啟導下看清前路。科技提升運動表現，兩人體驗行山神器，還以應用程式分析跑姿。醫療結合AI技術亦對治療復康帶來幫助，主持嘗試操控手術機械臂，感覺似打機？藉瑜伽、飲食追尋健康態度，高Ling隨星級瑜伽達人黃佩霞伸展放鬆，再細味「綠星」餐廳支持本地食材與可持續飲食理念。

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈獻:唱錢粵
programme.desc: 音準、拍子大考驗，唱歌隨時有錢落袋！由Eric Sir擔任經理人的女團XiX，其中三位成員Crystal、Caitlin、Charlotte到來接受《唱錢》洗禮，透過挑戰Sing盤上不同歌曲難度「過三關」，甚至是最難的Monster關卡，向打爆九宮格的目標進發。觀眾只需用手機掃描螢幕上的QR Code，即可參與直播室互動，為挑戰者打氣，更有機會贏取福利。

programme.title: 伯樂音樂學院20週年呈獻：J Music粵
programme.desc: 「偶像零距離」請來陳曉東的三十年粉絲向他發問，最佳男主角、最受歡迎男歌星，會怎樣選？東東亦獻唱經典作<水瓶座和<一萬年外，及新歌<今天我們都會飛。林智樂的新歌<The Red Button，笑言旨在摑醒身邊的「戀愛腦」？戴祖儀演繹<成長是個陷阱，這歌原來是她DSE時已寫下？另外，本集節目會倒數「勁歌金榜」排名，也有楊千嬅細說<回歸一塊小石頭的概念，並預告音樂動向。

programme.title: 風味人間 第2季粵
programme.desc: 中國人擅長以發酵醬料入饌。四川民眾會用二荊條製成豆瓣醬，是烹調麻婆豆腐等菜式的靈魂。墨西哥同樣盛產辣椒，加入朱古力調製出極具當地特色的魔力醬，還可變奏出甜、酸、苦等多重風味。法國廚師亦是醬汁高手，以葡萄酒與牛油製作的白汁醬，搭配魚類或菜蔬皆滋味無窮。潮汕民眾嚐吃牛肉火鍋時必配沙茶醬，據說這醬料跟印尼的沙嗲醬淵源甚深。印尼人喜以肉串火烤配沙嗲醬，中國人則將沙茶醬融入水產、肉材、麵食之中，各具特色。

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 傑出運動員選舉揭盅，蔡俊彥、何詩蓓膺星中之星，搜羅頒獎禮盛況。空手道青年港將、全港小學冠軍坦言視師姐劉慕裳為偶像，並得義教支持下投身這項運動。體育舞蹈亦湧現新星，三名年輕拉丁舞者訴說登「世一」感受。一對小學羽毛球「姊妹花」奪學界精英賽女雙冠軍，姊姊為與妹妹圓夢從單打轉雙打？香港東方獲甲一籃球總冠軍，並舉行慶功宴。跑步愛好者齊聚啟德飛步跑；匹克球慈善賽邀藝人切磋球技。另檢視中學生備戰學界體能賽情況。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 在剛過去的香港國際影視展，有不少生成式AI服務公司，展出它們的應用方案。這些AI方案如何改變電影的製作模式？內地微短劇市場不斷擴大，而AI亦有應用於不同的製作環節，情況如何？

programme.title: 叠影狙擊#13粵PG
programme.desc: 飛在模型店找到線索，杰依循線索找到貨倉，卻身陷險境，晨前往營救亦被勒暈，幸杰下屬及時趕到現場。因殺杰和晨事敗，金夫人要插手此事的諾負責越國的生意，諾自知是明賞暗罰。Mag為除後患，再設局引晨去貨倉…

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 港產旅行團粵
programme.desc: 山系KOL誓要征服大帽山！登山之前，衍峰與祖儀、穎彤到川龍村舊式茶樓歎早茶，細嚐懷舊風味點心。醫飽肚，輕輕鬆鬆步上觀景台，居高臨下睇靚景。再往山頂尋找芒草、席地野餐，等待長夜星空，湯兆昇博士傳授拍攝壯麗「星流跡」貼士。衍峰、穎彤、淑雅緊接展開軍事要塞之旅，順道認識松林炮台、摩星嶺炮台、銀禧炮台等歷史故事。終站來到日落觀瀾亭，楊潮凱不忘替穎彤拍下夕陽醉影。衍峰、穎彤決戰室內競技遊戲，激鬥蓄勢待發！

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 邏輯是指推論與證明的思想過程，對哲學、數學、科學和語言學等領域都十分重要，谷主凱婷還以象形文字作為例子。谷主汛文、凱文均認為身在不同狀況會影響邏輯分析，已「做功課」的凱婷嘗試向拍檔解說演繹推理、歸納推理與類比推理的相關概念。凱婷又引述「為何要學習邏輯」的古希臘典故，詳情如何？她亦還準備了「燒腦」問題，結果拍檔汛文、凱文面對「BB級」題目亦未能過關。三人還會討論可怎樣訓練邏輯思維，為觀眾提供建議。

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 嘉欣歸隊同遊沙巴，敏之、高Ling獻吻歡迎好姊妹。下榻酒店前先玩尋人遊戲，三位主持根據照片線索，周圍尋找男導遊，誰可率先完成任務？傾盆大雨，無阻美女們探索亞庇文化村之行。學習釀造米酒期間，三人意外獲得蜜蜂的熱情招待……她們還會拿起鋸刀自製竹筒杯，又挑戰原始吹箭，有人竟一擊即中？見識過原住民在傳統彈床遊戲展現的驚人彈跳力，主持們亦要體驗一番。玩樂之後，三人享用海鮮大餐，一嚐另類的海鮮肉骨茶。

programme.title: 成人教科書粵
programme.desc: 節目組準備了幾段外語錄音，要小朋友單憑聲調語氣，猜想對方說話時的情感。日語的溫柔聲調，就令人誤以為必定是開心情緒，語言原來會影響觀感？提起印度人，小朋友會聯想到甚麼？永城帶港孩吳柏翹、何朗怡和來自南韓的金炫志到訪夏利里拉家族大宅，富麗堂皇的裝修陳設，印度小孩的帥氣打扮，都令訪客感到驚訝！小朋友們透過傳統的Hanna、瑜伽與康樂棋，體驗印度文化後，對印度人也有所改觀；柏翹更直言想結識更多印度朋友。

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 哇揚皮影偶戲除了是一種提供視覺享受的傳統表演藝術, 更是傳遞宗教及哲學訊息的媒界 哇揚戲偶分為以皮革製作的皮影偶及木頭製作的木偶, 全靠工匠的巧手以精湛的手藝為戲偶賦予生命, 才能成就精彩的哇揚皮影偶戲

programme.title: 翻生工程粵英
programme.desc: 工程師Rob Bell帶大家探討將廢棄結構轉變為未來建築背後的重大挑戰。

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛秘。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰才是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 紳士與小姐
programme.desc: 【韓國收視破38%韓版《真善美》重拾幸福時光】《我唯一的守護者》編劇金始慶最新家庭劇新作，與爸爸、繼母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因繼兄繼母闖禍被詐騙，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面對爸爸的偏坦對待，朴丹丹憤而離家，因緣際會下來到有錢人家擔任住宿教師，陪伴失去母親的三個孩子，而他們的爸爸便是高冷霸道總裁李英國，在妻子早逝後，英國的內心漸漸封閉，與孩子間也產生隔閡，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出現，加上孩子們的湊合，幸福將再次降臨。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【離家追夢，還是回家團圓？馮家菜北漂生存戰】馮家菜是北京頗具名氣的淮揚菜館，女強人大米憑藉一身拼勁，將小館打造成金字招牌，卻因妹夫欠債，陷入食品安全風波，生意一落千丈。為救餐館，她請出退休父親參賽，奪得全國冠軍，卻招來資本大鱷周路的覬覦。親情與利益交織，事業與愛情碰撞，兄妹間信任破裂，馮家菜面臨生死存亡。當大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子終於悔悟，全家攜手重建家業。當揚州炒飯再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改變。

programme.title: 生活家
programme.desc: 【金馬演員攜手演出破產母女生存記】少見的審計職場劇，樂觀正向，帶給人心激勵。從小在拮据家庭成長的邱冬娜，在課業工作上總是特別勤奮，希望透過自己的努力讓母親過上好生活。畢業後，因緣際會下進入了前輩顧飛開的審計稽核公司，面對孤僻但能力強的主管顧飛，邱冬娜雖然頭痛但絕不認輸！運用從母親身上學到的智慧，還有艱困生活帶給她的精打細算體質，邱冬娜總能屢出奇招化解艱難任務。曾有心理創傷的主管顧飛，也在邱冬娜的陪伴下，兩人亦師亦友,相互扶持鼓勵，逐漸治癒傷口，成為彼此的靈魂伴侶。

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【離家追夢，還是回家團圓？馮家菜北漂生存戰】馮家菜是北京頗具名氣的淮揚菜館，女強人大米憑藉一身拼勁，將小館打造成金字招牌，卻因妹夫欠債，陷入食品安全風波，生意一落千丈。為救餐館，她請出退休父親參賽，奪得全國冠軍，卻招來資本大鱷周路的覬覦。親情與利益交織，事業與愛情碰撞，兄妹間信任破裂，馮家菜面臨生死存亡。當大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子終於悔悟，全家攜手重建家業。當揚州炒飯再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改變。

programme.title: 我的野蠻王妃
programme.desc: 【神級經典韓劇，尹恩惠、朱智勳、金楨勳、宋智孝再現現代宮廷指腹為婚！！】申采靜原本只是一名平凡無奇的高中學生，得知爺爺的遺囑中，她與皇太子李信有婚約在身。因家中債務的原因，在無可奈何的情況完婚。待在皇室的申采靜對宮內生活十分反彈，此時海歸回來的皇位第二繼承者李律及李信前女友閔孝琳的存在，展開錯綜複雜的故事。

programme.title: 另一種藍
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事業失意返鄉傳承青花瓷再現風華！！】北漂少女陳小滿努力工作、省吃儉用為求入股家族瓷器事業，卻以失敗收場，毅然決然回景德鎮專心學習瓷器工藝。陳小滿工作的上司柯巖則在投資上遭遇前所未有的失利，輾轉來到景德鎮。處於低潮的兩人在互相治癒中重新找回站起來的力量，事業重新起步，愛情也開始萌芽。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 六龍飛天
programme.desc: 李成桂為了正式的投身政治啓程去往開京，李芳遠也跟隨着父親去了開京。來到開京的李芳遠看到了置百姓死活於不顧只為自己填飽肚子的權文勢族，無法抑制住自己內心的憤怒。原本就對於李成桂的政界出仕很警惕的李仁謙將李成桂邀請到自己家裏並舉辦了宴會，在宴會上李仁謙給他看了以他背叛了曾經像兄弟一樣的趙小生為題材的街頭劇。在宴會結束後李成桂為了讓李仁謙保守自己背叛趙末生的秘密，向李仁謙低下了頭，李芳遠目擊到了這一幕。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.desc: The Squirrels are looking for Duggee but can't find him. Instead, they find someone who looks like Enid, only much too big. Duggee has painted his face to look like Enid!

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the "speed gang", led by Johnny, and Kuo's sister Carrie is molested by Johnny's brother Michael. Kuo's family continues to be harassed by the "speed gang" while on the island - can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of women's rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: Shaolin Intruders
programme.desc: On a routine courier mission, the prestigious Chief was murdered by four mysterious monks. When all evidence pointed to Ching Hua, his friend Lei decides to clear his name by barging in the Shaolin Temple thrice. When Lei thought justice was served for the culprits, he soon realizes the table had turned and the monks stroke again. What follows is a series of intense pursuit for the ultimate villain!

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: The Daredevils
programme.desc: Corrupt general Wang Li assumes power by killing his superior. The son of the murdered superior befriends four street performers called "The Venoms", and they help him take revenge by posing as government officials offering a peace token to the corrupt general. When Wang arrives at a warehouse, he is ambushed by the Venoms!

programme.title: Angel with the Iron Fists
programme.desc: Lo Wei directs and stars as the chief detective in this gripping thriller; playing alongside Lily Ho, who excels in the role of an undercover avenger that can fight as well as she flirts! Caught between the crime bosses known as Baldhead and Black Widow, she only has four choices: punch, kick, shoot or bombard with explosives!

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: Lady With A Sword
programme.desc: Swordswoman Feng tries to find a group of villains responsible for her eldest sister's death, but is shocked to discover that her fiance, Jin, is one of them. At the same time, Jin's mother and the two other killers are planning to kill Feng. Can Feng fight back and take her revenge?

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Clan of Amazons
programme.desc: The martial arts world is plunged into terror when a mysterious figure known as the 'Embroidery Bandit' starts to attack convoys of precious materials. Seemingly unstoppable, the frightened clans decide to call on the expertise of Lu Xiao Feng, an inquisitive fighter and detective to capture the culprit.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the directorwriter's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his son's arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao's fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao's fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Li Xun Huan is a sentimental swordsman who has lived peacefully outside the martial arts world for the past ten years. He returns home after knowing that the Plum Blossom Bandit is back to his old tricks, only to find that everything has changed.

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: Cheng Chung (Derek Yee) and May (Liu Hsueh-hua), a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May insists Inspector Wang (Yueh Hua) in a bid to rescue some hostages. She shoots the thug under most peculiar circumstances. Then a series of tragedies occur.

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2
programme.desc: Only by bringing together the powerful Heaven Sword and the mighty Dragon Sabre can six martial arts sects struggling for supremacy be saved in this thrilling sequel to Chu Yuan's original hit.

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: Return of Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A band of ninjas slaughters the entire Wu Dang Clan and frames Du Gu Wu Di, chief of the Invincible Clan, for the deed. Yun masters the silkworm martial arts style and decides to take revenge for the Clan by challenging Wu Di, but is defeated and seriously hurt. Luckily, Master Li saves and treats him, allowing Yun to avoid the ninjas' pursuit.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake ones!).

programme.title: Life Gamble
programme.desc: Martial arts master Yu has retired for years but is invited to join force with another master Tao to fight against the four famous thieves and retrieve the stolen Dragon Jade. However, Tao's real plan is to possess the treasure himself and kills Yu after he defeats the thieves...

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people's livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the murderer or be killed by Gong. To prove his innocence, Chu decides to investigate the case...

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh (Glass Tears, Killer Clans) and Shi Szu (Lovers Destiny), who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they can't escape them all, and eventually the two end up in prison... it is either death or a fight to the end!

programme.title: Illicit Desire
programme.desc: This instant cult classic adapts three erotic and mystical tales from the Chinese classical works, with stories spanning across time from the Tang to Ming dynasties. The stories, filled with characters such as emperors, concubines, monks and fortune-tellers, intertwine in a world of adultery, lust and greed, alongside great costumes!

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: After years in prison, Lu Hu returns home to find himself set up by his ruthless brother Piao, who has taken over the family coal mine business and imprisoned their sister. Hu takes down Piao and saves his sister but their coal mine falls into the hands of a Japanese gang, which Hu and his sister must fight in order to get it back.

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: General Feng occupies the city of Shandong, and soldiers and civilians alike welcome him without knowing his tyrannical and lustful nature. His first official business is to inspect the brothels and take the prostitutes home to become his concubines. Feng is finally killed by his officers, but will the new general rule the city differently?

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Wei Chun is a cocky young man sentenced to jail for killing a man in a fight. One day, Wei Chun picks a fight with a seemingly defenseless old man who completely thrashes him! The old man turns out to be the master of monkey style kung fu and as they become friends, he gives Wei Chun half of a medallion that would direct him to hidden secrets.

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: My Young Auntie
programme.desc: An elderly landowner marries young Dai Nan to keep his inheritance away from his unscrupulous nephew before he dies. When Dai Nan brings along the deed to meet his other nephew, a series of amusing incidents happen with this "young" auntie, the nephew and his son. Kara Hui won Best Actress in the first Hong Kong Film Awards for her role as Dai Nan.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: Duel For Gold
programme.desc: Six swordsmen, including two sisters and their husbands, a ranger and a security man, are trying to steal a million gold taels from the Fu Lai Treasury House, not knowing that one of them is actually an undercover hero. In their quest, they have to double-cross and outwit one another...

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: This is a love story between an alluring fairy, Seventh Sister, who comes down from heaven to experience life in 70's Hong Kong, and a man who is running a debt laden orphanage. A heartless tycoon plans to take over the orphanage for its land but has to deal with Seventh Sister's magical powers as she aims to protect it from falling into his hands!

programme.title: The Black Butterfly
programme.desc: Kwan leads a double life as a waitress and as an infamous outlaw skilled in martial arts, The Black Butterfly. When she steals a cache of gold from the Five Devils Rock bandits, she soon has the bandits, and the government, on her tail.

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: A young scholar Ning spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He does not believe in the rumours, but soon meets a beautiful female ghost Nie. Nie is forced to stay in the temple to seduce young men for a powerful demon to feast on. Knowing Nie to be a kind ghost, Ning decides to help her escape from the demon's clutches.

programme.title: Secret Service of the Imperial Court
programme.desc: Zhao Bu Fan is the sergeant of the government's secret police. Wang is a cruel and ruthless eunuch who takes over the Emperor's ruling power and leads the team of secret agents. After witnessing the atrocities committed by Eunuch Wang, Sergeant Zhao decides to defect but ends up being hunted by his friends, comrades and even his father.

programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao's spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll's eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation...

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man's father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man's matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes on a job as a night guard. As the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at the abandoned building, only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang's custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter -the sole witness- mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter's company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master who left the martial arts world to protect his lover. However, his disappearance leads to her tragic death and as Liang Kun finds a way to survive in the martial arts world, he fights back to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called "Kung Fu Stuntmen". This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.desc: After George and Harold learn the truth about their mission, Dupe Licitous enlists the entire crew in a quest to repair a rogue satellite.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Moon Shot
programme.desc: Our team’s startup company and their rivals at Baby Corp get in a "Space Race", competing to see who can make the cutest kiddie-pretend "moon landing" for a baby - a spectacle sure to bring in a bounty of Baby Love. With both companies pouring their resources into a simulated space take off, tempers and sabotage are running hot, and the scrappy little startup is in danger of getting crushed by their big business competitor.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S1 - Greening The Cube
programme.desc: Team Volron follows a distress signal to a planet that is half-mech, half-forest to rescue a king who has been kidnapped by the Galra

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S1 - Eye Of The Storm
programme.desc: Team Voltron seeks to rest and recharge on the surface of an ice planet

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The Train Tycoon
programme.desc: While Lucky is eager to celebrate her first birthday on the frontier, a surprise visit from her Grandpa stirs up a controversy.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Frog Croaks
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Frog didn't croak. Frog sang like a bird… and the birds didn't like it. Birds were the masters of song and that's the way it should be! So the birds trick poor old Frog into a singing duel and sing and sing and sing… until poor old Frog's voice is reduced to a rebbit. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Spider Has A Tiny Waist
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Spider didn't have a tiny waist. She was all big and round… and did she like her food! One day greedy Spider hears of Four Feasts in Tinga Tinga and she wanted to go to them all! So she spun four threads and attached them to various animals going to the feasts. But the Monkeys, Frog, Hippo and the Bees all set off in different directions - North, South, East and West - and Spider's thread soon runs out.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - New Juice
programme.desc: Conrod is visiting Silver Hatch to try out some new bio fuel. But Big Chris fears something is wrong with it after he comes out in spots after sampling a smoothie made from the same produce. What or who could be at fault?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Fb For Football
programme.desc: The cars are having a football tournament down at the beach. FB learns that if he relaxes, his natural footballing skills will shine through.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Mr Carburettor's Birthday Suit
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor is off to try out his new wetsuit at the beach… it may come in useful when rain is forecast for the big race the next day!

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Big Bangs
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor is planning a big firework display up at the farm. Can Roary help Tin Top overcome his fear of bangs in time for the display?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Silver Hatch Pizza
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor has demanded pizza for lunch but the pizzeria is closed. How is Marsha going to ensure Mr Carburettor gets the lunch he asked for?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Silver Hatch Stars
programme.desc: Roary is feeling put out as all the cars are paying Conrod too much attention. He is determined to show his worth when they race that afternoon. But tries too hard and ends up in danger. Who can save him?

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Mom’s Birthday Angry
programme.desc: Kelp and Scallop enlist Cruz’s help to perform a dance for Mom’s birthday. Though it’s hard at first, they learn to put their dolphin, unicorn, and narwhal powers together to create something special. Kelp, Pixie, Ollie, and their friend Leroy try to help Juniper understand her angry feelings.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Sick Day
programme.desc: When the other dragons come down with the flu, Summer must overcome her fear of eels to retrieve the cure and get her friends back in the air.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - The King Who Would Be King
programme.desc: Fred the Giant Scorpion vows revenge after he reads an untrue story about himself in King Julien's new book.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - Are You There Frank? It's Me, King Julien
programme.desc: Frank the Sky God comes to the lemur kingdom to prove his existence - and to demand the ultimate sacrifice: King Julien himself.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Ludicrous Lunacy of the Loopy Laserlightmare
programme.desc: Despite being terrible at the job, Krupp wants to be the camp director again next summer. That's something Harold and George simply cannot abide.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Shocking Showdown of the Staggering Sugamechangere
programme.desc: It's parents' weekend at Lake Summer Camp, and Krupp's eager to make amends with Harold and George ... or so he says.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - RoboCleve
programme.desc: The kids hatch a plan to take down Cleve and rescue Ms. Nowhere and Gary. Meanwhile, despite interference from Ziri, Cleve successfully begins to launch his satellites into space, which will allow him to use his weather machine to destroy Earth’s major cities and transform the Sahara into the only oasis. In order to stop the satellites, the team engages in an all-out battle against Cleve, Matsuo, and Rafaela.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Sirocco Fire Explosion
programme.desc: Cleve has the team surrounded - is this the end? Suddenly, Cisco bursts in to save the day, along with all of the friends the team has made along the way in the Sahara. Working together, they manage to stop Cleve’s missiles and defeat Rafaela and Matsuo. But before they get a chance to celebrate, a giant fire tornado tears its way through the Sahara destroying everything in its path. Tony decides to make one last daring attempt in order to save the day.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - New Hat, New Tag! Furry Tail Ending
programme.desc: When Tag worries that she's no longer a "Go" dog, Lady Lydia helps her find a new persona by helping Tag try on a bunch of different hats. Luckily, when a runaway puppy needs to be wrangled, and only the speedy Tag can catch him, Tag realizes she was a Go dog all along. \ Sergeant Pooch reads Scooch, Tag and Kit a story book during their sleepover. But when the last pages are missing, the three kids work together to make up their own ending to the story.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Bigpaw, Big Problems Captain Scooch and Scally-Tag
programme.desc: Tag, Scooch and Kit think they found the perfect story for their newspaper: Bigpaw is in Pawston! But when they find out that Frank and Beans were lying to the town, they seek to uncover the truth and reveal it to everyone. \ When Sam Whippet sets up a pirate-themed race for the Race Cadets, pirate-loving Scooch takes on the role of captain. Tag struggles to take orders as first mate while helping Scooch navigate maritime obstacles and avoid the fearsome pirates.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Where’s The Party? The Noisiest Night
programme.desc: When Marcus loses an invitation to a birthday party and doesn’t know where it will take place, the Dew Drops set out to find the location and get Marcus to the party on time. When Harper can’t sleep because of a strange noise in her room, the Dews must figure out the source.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Escape The Backpack Play Date
programme.desc: While helping Lola pack for her first day of camp, the Dews get stuck inside her backpack! Using the random items inside, the Dews get crafty in their attempt to break out. When Eden and Phoebe join Harper and Marcus for a playdate, the Dews disagree on what activity their kids should do, ultimately learning that there are lots of ways to play!

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - The Amazing Donna Bye, Bye Boardie
programme.desc: When Donna decides to show off her not-so-flashy skills as a magician at the Community Center talent show, the Zenkos must do everything they can to save her act from becoming an embarrassing disaster. After Sam’s favorite skateboard accidentally gets put in with donations Mr. Tanaka is collecting for a fundraiser, the team is led on a merry chase as the skateboard passes from one Harmony Harbor denizen to another.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Lula's Last Stand Triple Trouble
programme.desc: Little Lula has set up a lemonade stand, but she’s not getting any business. The Zenkos swing into action to send customers her way. When Donna, Fawna and Rona have a spat, the triplets’ longstanding annual tradition of viewing a comet together is in jeopardy. Now it’s up to Team Zenko to get the three feuding sisters back together again before the comet streaks by.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - DJ Catnip Gets His Groove Back
programme.desc: Gabby brings DJ Catnip a microphone for him to use in the big music show, but he has some terrible news: he lost his groove! Determined to help him get his groove back, Gabby and Pandy take him on a musical search through the dollhouse. As they go, Gabby uses the microphone to record sounds from the Gabby Cats’ everyday activities that culminate into a new song that gets DJ his groove back just in time for the show! In our Gabby Cat of the Day Segment, Gabby sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Fairy Gets Sick
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a recipe for dandelion soup and a soup bowl, she discovers Kitty Fairy is sick! Gabby and Pandy make her some delicious dandelion soup and while she rests, they take care of her Garden. With the help of all the Gabby Cats, they water the Singing Flowers, help the Rainbow Kitty Bushes regain their color, and sing some fussy Itty Bitty Blossoms a lullaby. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Kitty Fairy sings a song!

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - Grugs First Chance Furry Road

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - My Big Fat Gran Wedding The Strutting Edge
